info.name: Service 3 - Incident Management (Elie Medawar)
info.description:
Incident Management Service, port 5003. Needs the Users, Logs, Notifications and Assets services running, and an existing asset id in {{asset_id}}. Developed by: Elie Medawar.

Uses the users created by the Users collection (admin, rami, lara, nadia). Set the *_password variables locally first.
